text: 25 YEARS. WE WILL NEVER FORGET.[image]AFGHANISTAN[image][image]At the end of a beautiful day here on Cape Cod, we pause and remember.[image][image]Twenty-five years ago today, the war in Afghanistan began. For 20 years, brave Americans and our allies served, sacrificed, and answered the call.[image][image]We remember those who made the ultimate sacrifice, like Nicholas. We remember those who were wounded. We remember the families who lost husbands, wives, sons and daughters.[image][image]But we also want to remember all those who came home and continue to serve.[image][image]They are all around us. They are police officers and firefighters. They are teachers, mechanics, business owners, fathers, mothers and neighbors. They continue to serve their communities and make a difference every day.[image][image]To every Afghanistan veteran: You served. You sacrificed. You made a difference. Be proud of your service, because we are forever proud of you.[image]🇺🇸🙏🏻🫡[image]#RepX #Fightin5th #ProudAmericans #Afghanistan #USA #HonorAndRespect #LivingTheDream [image]The Nicholas G. A GREAT DAY AT MASSACHUSETTS MARITIME ACADEMY! [image][image]It was great to welcome Texas State Representative Terry Wilson and his wife to the world-renowned Massachusetts Maritime Academy today, right here on beautiful Buzzards Bay.[image][image]Chairman Wilson is visiting maritime academies around the country to learn how different states support their academies and how we can continue to strengthen these important institutions.[image][image]We had a great conversation about Massachusetts Maritime Academy and the many things Texas can learn from the experience here as they work to improve and strengthen their own maritime academy.[image][image]It was a pleasure to show Chairman Wilson and his wife around campus with Admiral McDonald, Captain Simmons, and Senator Dylan Fernandes’ team. We talked about cadets, workforce development, training facilities, funding and the important role our maritime academies play in our national security and economy.[image][image]More than 1,000 cadets, all in uniform, were on campus today. What an incredible sight and an incredible place.[image][image]Massachusetts Maritime Academy is truly one of the great institutions in our Commonwealth, and we are proud to have it right here in the Fightin’ Fifth.[image][image]If you have a son, daughter, grandson, granddaughter, or loved one attending Massachusetts Maritime Academy, be proud![image][image]GO BUCS! FOR SEAN[image]What an incredible day back in Yarmouth at the K9 Sergeant Sean M. Gannon Training Center — the house that Sean built.[image][image]Today’s state-of-the-art K9 training brought together incredible police officers and some truly incredible dogs. There is so much that goes into properly training a K9 team, including teaching officers how to safely serve as decoys and teaching these dogs how to properly bite, hold and release.[image][image]These officers are committed to doing the job right, and these dogs are absolutely amazing.[image][image]Our family is proud to be in a position to help provide this training through a $5,000 grant from Big Nick’s Ride and the Nicholas G. Xiarhos Memorial Fund, in memory Nick, and in memory of the son of our good friends, Denise and Patrick Gannon.[image][image]Sean Gannon. Big Nick Xiarhos. Two sons. Two fallen heroes. [image][image]There is something very powerful about seeing the legacy of these young men helping protect the men and women who put their lives on the line every day.[image][image]We will always Back the Blue, and we will do everything we can to help provide our police officers and K9 teams with the training and equipment they need to do their jobs safely and effectively.[image][image]Pain to purpose.[image]🇺🇸💙🐕🐾🙏🏻[image]#RepX #Fightin5th #ProudAmerican #ServiceBeforeSelf #GiveBack #BackTheBlue #K9 #CapeCod #Massachusetts #MaPoli #ForSean[image]Town of Yarmouth Massachusetts[image]Yarmouth Police Foundation[image]Yarmouth Police Dept.[image]Town of Barnstable[image]Barnstable Police Department[image]Barnstable Police K9 Foundation[image]K9 PTSD Center[image]The Plymouth County Sheriff's Department[image]Falmouth Police Department[image]Veterans Collaborative[image]Riptide K-9

GOOD MORNING & HAPPY THANKFUL THURSDAY [image]Operation Flags for Vets[image][image]Today we are especially thankful for the Monti family and the incredible tradition they continue to carry on in honor of their son and brother, U.S. Army Sergeant Jared C. Monti.[image][image]Jared was born and raised right here in Massachusetts and gave his life serving our country in Afghanistan. His incredibly strong and proud father, Paul Monti, turned his unimaginable loss into a lasting mission of love, remembrance and service.[image][image]That mission became Operation Flags for Vets.[image][image]Twice a year, during Veterans Day week and Memorial Day week, volunteers gather at our Massachusetts National Cemetery in Bourne to place American flags on the graves of our fallen heroes.[image][image]People come from all over. Young and old. Veterans, families, friends and complete strangers. They walk among the graves, place a flag, and say the name of the hero who rests there.[image][image]That is what makes this tradition so powerful.[image][image]It reminds us that these men and women are not forgotten.[image][image]As the years have gone by, the tradition continues. The Monti family continues to lead, and thousands of people continue to show up to honor Jared and every hero who made the ultimate sacrifice for our country.[image][image]Flag Placement Day is November 7th at 9:00 AM.[image]Flag Pickup Day is November 14th at 9:00 AM.[image][image]We hope to see you there.[image][image]God bless the Monti Gold Star family, every Gold Star family who carries this loss every single day, and all those who have served, all those who continue to serve, and every volunteer who takes the time to place and retrieve these flags.[image][image]Happy Thankful Thursday, Cape Cod.
